values: whether the permit was administratively continued

grounding.excerpt_ref: Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase (*8) (*11) limits row

rationale: The packet documents footnote (*11) temporal scope (*11 applies from three years after the permit effective date through expiration and any administrative continuation; *10 applies for the first three years after effective date) and the (*11) numeric limits, but it does not include the permit effective date, permit expiration date, or whether the permit was administratively continued. Without those dates and status, Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) cannot be mapped onto the (*10) versus (*11) schedule, so the extent to which the (*11) TDS Net Increase limits apply during that period cannot be established. Neither an affirmative applicability determination (ACCEPT) nor a definitive inapplicability determination (REJECT) is supported.
